title: Moth Trap Catch Volume by Night Temperature
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mothtrap:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(catch_count) as catch_count avg(night_temp_c) as avg_night_temp_c by _time trap_id
| sort - _time
description: Tracks moth trap catch volume over time and breaks it out by trap.
value: Catch volume next to night temperature helps separate seasonal ecology from equipment changes.
implementation: Send moth trap catch volume events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of moth trap catch volume by trap.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how moth trap catch volume changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
